title: Alibaba ActionTrail Baseline Ingestion

controlTest.positiveScenario: Replay or inject sample `alibaba:actiontrail` events matching `*` into `index=alibaba`. Confirm UC-4.8.1 search returns >=1 row and alert fires.
controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `alibaba:actiontrail` traffic without `*` markers. Confirm the search returns zero rows and alert does not fire.

dataSources: `index=alibaba` sourcetype=`alibaba:actiontrail` collected via Splunk Add-on for Alibaba Cloud (Splunkbase 4800); validate ingest with `| stats count by sourcetype`.

description: Verifies alibaba actiontrail baseline ingestion data flows into Splunk continuously.

detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=alibaba`.
• Install and configure Splunk Add-on for Alibaba Cloud (Splunkbase 4800) with the modular input for `alibaba:actiontrail`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): none.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `eventName` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Enable alibaba:actiontrail ingestion via the appropriate Splunk TA into index=alibaba.
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=alibaba sourcetype="alibaba:actiontrail" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=alibaba sourcetype="alibaba:actiontrail"
| table _time eventName userIdentity.userName resourceName
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.8.1_alibaba_actiontrail_base_1"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `alibaba:actiontrail` in `index=alibaba` to detect alibaba actiontrail baseline ingestion. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail console for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `eventName` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_8_1_alert` with severity aligned to `critical` criticality. Dashboard: Ingestion health single value and lag chart..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade Splunk Add-on for Alibaba Cloud (Splunkbase 4800) and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of alibaba actiontrail baseline ingestion so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
